wikipediaRead.identityBasisJa: 記事のDebir行を確認。別のDebir（JOS15:7）を別行にし、JOS10:38–39用例の行には複数候補を掲載。JOS15:49等も同じ行の参照に含むため、ユダ山地の属性はJOS10:38の読者向け常時欄には転記しない。
wikipediaRead.pageTextEvidence: Cities in the Book of Joshua rendered page: table heading “The list of cities and suggested locations” and Debir rows; Debir of Judah 1 lists Joshua 10:38–39 among its references and gives multiple archaeological candidates; a separate Debir of Judah 2 row covers Joshua 15:7. The article table also incorporates later JOS references, so later regional classification is excluded from always-visible first-occurrence prose.
